item.title: Design a Web Crawler
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Crawl a billion pages a month without getting banned. The URL frontier that enforces politeness and priority, BFS over the web graph, spider traps, near-duplicate detection with SimHash, and what RFC 9309 changed about robots.txt.
